claim: The bundled dry-run works locally without Docker or network access and writes a go/no-go JSON report and runbook.
where: landing first-screen facts and demo terminal, README
sandbox: fresh temporary directory; run the release CLI demo with no executable PATH and all network proxies pointed at a closed loopback port; assert report.json and runbook.md contain GO and rollback status

claim: The URL guard accepts only an exact localhost or loopback host and refuses remote-looking URLs.
where: landing privacy section, README, CLI help
sandbox: release CLI; accept exact IPv4/IPv6 loopback URLs; refuse remote hosts containing localhost, disposable, .test, credentials, or query decoys

claim: Without a license action, the documentation site makes only same-origin requests and stores no visitor data.
sandbox: fresh desktop and 390px browser contexts; inspect every request, local/session storage and cookies across all routes

claim: The CLI supports Postgres and ClickHouse and rejects other engine names.
sandbox: fresh temporary directory; produce dry-run cards for Postgres and ClickHouse; reject MySQL before creating output

claim: Demo reset deletes only a directory marked by a prior mlr demo run.
sandbox: temporary paths only; remove one marked demo, then prove unmarked, workspace, home, current-directory and symlink targets survive

claim: Opening ?demo=1 starts an isolated sample recording, and Reset demo restarts it without browser storage.
where: landing demo action and demo page
sandbox: fresh browser context; open ?demo=1, record the first displayed terminal line, wait for another line, click Reset demo, and assert the first line returns with empty storage

claim: The browser sample terminal is recorded from the bundled release CLI dry-run.
sandbox: build the release CLI; execute its dry-run into a temporary output folder and assert the checked-in recording names the same command and report files

claim: The bundled Postgres and ClickHouse demos use invented customer records with no connection URL.
sandbox: read both shipped fixtures; assert documented invented records and absence of database connection URLs

claim: Reports stay in the non-blank output directory the operator names.
sandbox: fresh working directory; assert both reports occur only below the chosen output and a blank output fails without files

claim: A Docker rehearsal loads supplied SQL, overlaps the workload with the migration, and records time, lock waits, table bytes, and rollback status.
where: landing how-it-works and install sections, README
sandbox: GitHub Actions Ubuntu runner with Docker; run bundled Postgres 16 and ClickHouse 24.8 samples, then assert measured report fields and no mlr containers remain. Local machines without Docker mark this integration test skipped.

claim: The CLI removes its disposable Docker container after a successful or failed rehearsal.
where: landing install section, README, CLI help
sandbox: GitHub Actions Ubuntu runner with Docker; run bundled samples and assert no mlr container remains after each completed rehearsal. Local machines without Docker mark this integration test skipped.

claim: A missing or failed rollback writes NO-GO and exits non-zero for Postgres and ClickHouse.
sandbox: deterministic Docker command double omits and fails rollback for each engine; assert exit status, JSON verdict and runbook verdict

claim: A failed Docker command at any rehearsal stage writes a NO-GO report and runbook and exits non-zero.
where: landing limits section, README, CLI help
sandbox: deterministic Docker command double fails startup, container start, setup, copy, fixture, workload, measurement, and migration for both engines; assert non-zero exit, NO-GO JSON stdout/file, failure stage, null missing measurement, recovery runbook, and cleanup after a container was named

claim: A migration, workload, or rollback command that exceeds the configured statement deadline is terminated, writes a NO-GO report and runbook, and removes its disposable container.
sandbox: deterministic Docker command double leaves each active migration, workload, or rollback command open; run both engines with a 10 ms deadline and assert a non-zero exit, NO-GO JSON/stdout/runbook, timeout stage, and docker rm -f

claim: SIGINT or SIGTERM during a rehearsal terminates active migration, workload, or rollback commands, writes a NO-GO report, and removes the disposable container.
sandbox: deterministic hanging migration and rollback commands; send SIGINT and SIGTERM to the release CLI for both engines after each starts, then assert non-zero exit, NO-GO report, failure stage, and docker rm -f

claim: The default limits are 30,000 ms statement time, 1,000 ms lock wait, and 104,857,600 bytes table growth. Default and configured limits appear in the JSON report and runbook, and determine the verdict.
where: landing demo report, README, CLI help
sandbox: release CLI help and deterministic Docker measurements for both engines; assert all exact defaults, configured override values, JSON/runbook inclusion, and NO-GO verdicts

claim: JSON output stays valid when a migration filename contains control characters.
sandbox: fresh temporary directory and valid Unix filename containing a newline; parse report.json and --json stdout and assert the original filename

claim: The hosted checkout shows a $29 one-time operator license. Terms name Sociobot/Dodo as merchant of record and refund handler. A valid returned or pasted license is stored locally, verified at most once daily, reveals the operator checklist, and can be removed.
sandbox: one live Sociobot checkout request with redirect following disabled plus a fresh browser context with a recorded verification response; assert HTTP 303 to checkout.dodopayments.com, $29 disclosure, terms merchant/refund disclosure, URL token stripping, namespaced storage, daily cache, paid checklist, restore, and removal

claim: Reports and safety checks do not require a license.
sandbox: fresh temporary directory with no license variables, no browser storage, and network proxy set to closed loopback; run demo, guard, and rehearsal argument validation without any license request
